Their case, in short, is that in 1926 Moina Prasad Chowdhury being owner in possession in 14.42 acre of land of CS plot Nos. 447, 448 and 495 appertaining to CS khatian Nos. 50, 51, 52, 53 and 54 at present of Mohammadpur transferred, 2.06 acre of land to Abbad Ali alias Abbas Fakir by a registered deed No. 2648. Similarly, Moina Chowdhury exhausted all his interest in said land by transfer of 2.06 acres each to other six persons 2.06 acre of land was recorded in khatian No. 35 in SA record of rights in the name Of Abbas Fakir who then died leaving his heirs and legal representatives. By successive transfer, Golam Rahman and Mohammad Hossain acquired 16½ decimals of land of plot No. 447 by registered deed No. 1721 and 1977 dated 27-7-1977 and 12-7-1977. Then, out of said land, Golam Rahman and Mohammad Hossain transferred 13 decimals of Johura Khatun, mother of said opposite parties by two deeds being No. 18959 and 18960 dated 26-5-1978 Johura Khatun filled the land with earth, erected 6 feet high boundary walls and tin roofed house with pucca lavatory, bathroom, kitchen and four verandas, and let out to tenants. She got her name mutated in the revenue record as well as in the municipality, water and gas connection and possessed on payment of various rates, rents and taxes, and also through tenants. In October, she died leaving said opposite parties as husband, sons and daughters.

Similarly, said Moina Prasad exhausted all his interest in said land by transfer of 2.06 acre each to other six persons, 2.06 acre of land was recorded in khatian No. 35 in SA record of rights in the name of Abbas Fakir who then died leaving his heirs and legal representatives. Out of said land, Abdul Kadir and Abdul Rashid by deed Nos. 8886 and 8882 dated 1-6-1966 acquired some land, and then, transferred 8½ ,decimals of land by deed No. 18734 dated 26-5-1978 to Aleya Huda. Abdul Kader by another deed dated 26-5-1978 transferred 16½ decimals of land to Johura Khatun, mother of opposite party Nos. 2 to 4 and delivered possession. Opposite Party No. 1 Aleya Huda and Jahura Khatun by demarcating their respective lands with boundary walls and erecting huts possessed through tenants and on payment of rates, rents and taxes. 

 18. We have gone through all the evidence and the papers relied upon by the parties. It appears that on 23-3-1992 the petitioner instituted Title Suit No. 59 of 1992 against one Dasu Roy Chowdhury represented by one Md Shahidullah Mia for specific performance of an agreement for sale. He made out the case that said Shahidullah as an attorney entered into the agreement with the petitioner for sale of 1.60 acre out of 5.20 acre of land of plot Nos. 447, 448 and 495 appertaining to khatian No. 50 of present mouje Mohammadpur and on receipt of Taka 15,000, executed and registered an agreement. Then, on 14-10-1991 Shahidullah received further Taka 1,00,000. On 29-7-1992 the petitioner and said Shahidullah made a joint application for compromise. On 14-9-1992 the suit was decreed on compromise. On 21-9-1992 the decree was signed. Then, on 6-11-1993 the petitioner levied the decree in Title Execution Case No. 29 of 1993 for possession of 1.60 acre out of 5.20 acre of land of plot Nos. 447, 448 and 495. On 8-3-1994 the petitioner made an application for police help for possession. Then, the executing Court allowed by its order dated 28-5-1994 an amendment by replacing plot No. 484 in place of plot No. 448. Again on 26-10-1994 the petitioner applied for police force. On 3-11-1994 the petitioner applied for direction to the Bailiff to deliver possession by breaking open the doors, if necessary. The same date a writ of delivery of possession was issued to deliver possession by breaking open the doors if so needed. On 5-11-1994 the process server reported that he delivered possession of 1.60 acre out of 5.20 acre of plot Nos. 447, 484 and 495 by removing all movables. On 8-11-1994 the petitioner made an application for dropping the execution proceedings since the effectiveness of the execution was over.
